html:
/* RecipeBox layout. Where the box sits (float parameter) is set inline by Template:RecipeBox,
   this page only adds a minimum width and the phone layout. */
.aa-recipebox {
  display: flow-root;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 320px; /* never squeezed narrower than this, also inside a row of boxes */
  min-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 2rem)); /* on very small screens: the screen width */
  flex: 0 0 auto;   /* a flex row (like display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap) wraps the box instead of shrinking it */
}
.aa-recipebox table.wikitable {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 100%;
}
 
/* Phones: a floated box gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .aa-recipebox-float {
    float: none !important;
    clear: both !important;
    margin: 0.5em 0 !important;
  }
}
